import Mathlib

inductive BinarySearchTree : Type
| Empty : BinarySearchTree
| Node : Int → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree
deriving Inhabited

def view (t : BinarySearchTree) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => ∅
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_bst (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => True
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

def get_left (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option BinarySearchTree :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node _ l _ => some l
  | _ => none

def get_right (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option BinarySearchTree :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node _ _ r => some r
  | _ => none

def get_val (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option Int :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v _ _ => some v
  | _ => none

def BinarySearchTree.is_node (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node _ _ _ => True
  | _ => False

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def zigzag_precond (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  is_bst t ∧ 
  BinarySearchTree.is_node t ∧ 
  (match get_left t with 
   | some p => BinarySearchTree.is_node p ∧ 
               (match get_right p with 
                | some x => BinarySearchTree.is_node x 
                | none => False)
   | none => False)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def zigzag (t : BinarySearchTree) 
    (h_precond : zigzag_precond t) : BinarySearchTree :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node g (BinarySearchTree.Node p pl (BinarySearchTree.Node x xl xr)) gr =>
      BinarySearchTree.Node x (BinarySearchTree.Node p pl xl) (BinarySearchTree.Node g xr gr)
  | _ => t
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def zigzag_postcond (t : BinarySearchTree) (result : BinarySearchTree)
    (_ : zigzag_precond t) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_bst result ∧
  view result = view t ∧
  -- Structural properties: X (grandchild, originally P's right child) is now root
  get_val result = get_val (get_right (get_left t).get!).get!
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem zigzag_postcond_satisfied (t : BinarySearchTree)
    (h_precond : zigzag_precond t) :
    zigzag_postcond t (zigzag t h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  rcases t with _ | ⟨g, L, gr⟩
  · exact absurd h_precond.2.1 (by simp [BinarySearchTree.is_node])
  rcases L with _ | ⟨p, pl, X⟩
  · exact absurd h_precond.2.2 (by simp [get_left, BinarySearchTree.is_node])
  rcases X with _ | ⟨x, xl, xr⟩
  · exact absurd h_precond.2.2 (by simp [get_left, get_right, BinarySearchTree.is_node])
  obtain ⟨hbst, -⟩ := h_precond
  simp only [is_bst] at hbst
  obtain ⟨hPg, ⟨hplp, hpl, hXp, hxlx, hxl, hxrx, hxr⟩, hgrg, hgr⟩ := hbst
  have hpx : p < x := hXp x (by simp [view])
  have hxg : x < g := hPg x (by simp [view])
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [zigzag, is_bst]
    refine ⟨?_, ⟨hplp, hpl, ?_, hxl⟩, ?_, ?_, hxr, hgrg, hgr⟩
    · intro y hy
      simp only [view, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
      rcases hy with (hy | hy) | hy
      · have := hplp y hy; omega
      · exact hxlx y hy
      · omega
    · intro y hy
      exact hXp y (by simp [view]; tauto)
    · intro y hy
      simp only [view, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
      rcases hy with (hy | hy) | hy
      · exact hxrx y hy
      · have := hgrg y hy; omega
      · omega
    · intro y hy
      exact hPg y (by simp [view]; tauto)
  · simp only [zigzag, view]
    ext y
    simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    tauto
  · simp [zigzag, get_val, get_left, get_right]
  -- !benchmark @end proof

**Approach:**

- **Implementation** (`Solution.lean:62-67`): pattern-match `t = Node g (Node p pl (Node x xl xr)) gr` and return `Node x (Node p pl xl) (Node g xr gr)` — X becomes root, P the left child, G the right child, with X's old subtrees `xl`/`xr` reattached to P and G respectively. The catch-all `_ => t` keeps the function total; the precondition rules those branches out in the proof.

- **Proof**: destructure `t` down three levels, discharging each degenerate shape from the precondition (`is_node` / `get_left` / `get_right` are `False` there). In the real case, unfolding `is_bst` gives the ordering facts, from which `p < x` and `x < g` follow by instantiating the parent/grandparent bounds at `x`. Then:
  - *BST*: new left subtree `Node p pl xl` is bounded above by `x` (`pl < p < x`, `xl < x`) and internally ordered since `xl`'s elements exceeded `p` already; new right subtree `Node g xr gr` is bounded below by `x` (`xr > x`, `gr > g > x`) and ordered since `xr`'s elements were below `g`.
  - *View*: both trees' views are the same six-way union, closed by `ext` + `tauto`.
  - *Structure*: `get_val result = some x` matches `get_val (get_right (get_left t).get!).get!` definitionally.

Only the `code` and `proof` marker regions were changed; `auxcode` and `lemma` stayed empty, and no other file was touched.
